meta.text: emotions can make it very difficult to decide whether to euthanize a pet , even when the pet is very sick . to make the decision process a little easier , look objectively at your hamsters behavior . for example , watch how he walks—if his back is arched or he is unsteady on his feet , he could be feeling extremely sick . hamsters love to run and play . if your hamster stays hunched over in a corner of his cage , he is very uncomfortable and likely very sick . make a list of several activities your hamster loves to do e . g . run in his hamster wheel , gnaw on chew toys , etc .
